name: Resistance Becomes Unbearable
game_text: <phase>Maneuver</phase>: Exert a twilight Nazgûl to exert the Ring-bearer. If the Ring-bearer is then exhausted, he puts on The One Ring until the regroup phase.
flavor_text: “Not with the hope of escape, or of doing anything, either good or bad: he simply felt that he must take the Ring and put it on his finger.”
